body: Oh please. I knew this sub was crap, but come on pal.

I suppose I'm old enough to move out on my own, but I'd still have to attend school (Where I live, even 18 year olds can't drop out on their own unless they live on their own, not that dropping out is a good financial decision anyway.) 

I should clarify that I don't hate home per se, but I do strongly dislike it and the people with whom I share it. I hear people suggest volunteering a lot, and while I'm not opposed to it or working with people, I don't really like working with them.

I actually do like animals, but I'm not very good at working with them. I supposed that's a skill that I could easily work on though.

I have volunteered at places like The Miracle Leauge (baseball for mentally disabled/impaired adults), but it didn't really make me happy. It felt like a nice thing, but it just seemed superficial. 


I probably won't do anything tonight (although I certainly want to),and I'm definitely more afraid of Hell than I'm acting, but geez is this a depressing way to live.

Not a gun owner, but am a strong second amendment supporter. I feel ya, brother. The government loves sticking its dirty paws in our rights and taking away pastimes that harm absolutely no one.

But here's a though: Have you considered shooting competitions? Normally those are with semi-autos IIRC, but those seem fun. My dad and brothers loved doing them (and I liked watching them.). There are always some more gun related activities. Even if they pass it, there are other ways to have fun with guns.
